roadmap.title: Prologue: cultists before the Chaos Spawn
roadmap.description: Use Daring or higher. Save before the final fight and prevent the Chaos Spawn from consuming a cultist.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1: Rykad and the evacuation
roadmap.description: Defeat the daemon under the Upperway and preserve every shuttle in Aurora’s fight. Begin the freight-line quests if Void Shadows is enabled.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2: build an Iconoclast protectorate
roadmap.description: Recruit Jae, Yrliet, and the DLC companions. Keep Foulstone. Retrieve both of Theodora’s data caches, befriend Nomos, and keep Argenta available for Commorragh. Finish exploration and time-sensitive ship quests before the chapter ends. Keep Jinevra alive, leave the Suspicious Rash untreated, and reserve saves before the ritual and the pirate funeral.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3: Commorragh
roadmap.description: Equip boots before the chapter starts. Recover companions, use stimms before meeting Malice, and let the Khymerae kill the allied gladiators in the first arena fight. Recruit Ulfar and Marazhai before leaving.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4: companions, colonies, and expansions
roadmap.description: Finish companion stories and rank V projects. Revisit optional sites and save before irreversible DLC decisions. Use a separate save for surrendering companions, then return to the save with your full party. Complete Expanse exploration before departing for Chapter 5.

roadmap.title: Chapter 5: Iconoclast ending and final DLC branches
roadmap.description: Stay on Daring or higher. Learn the Necron language, fight a Necron ship, and finish at Iconoclast Votary rank or higher. Keep Nomos available for the ending. Save before the final choices and Trazyn’s deals so you can reload for alternate outcomes.

roadmap.title: Dogmatic playthrough and Grim Darkness
roadmap.description: Finish another Daring-or-higher run with Dogmatic Votary rank or higher. Aim for Zealot in one conviction. Enable Grim Darkness at the start of one full playthrough; its single-save rules make separate branch saves unavailable during that run.

roadmap.title: Heretical playthrough
roadmap.description: Finish on Daring or higher with Heretical Votary rank or higher. Follow the Chaos route on Eufrates II and recruit Uralon. Collect any remaining branch-specific achievements.

achievements.description: You completed the Prologue.
achievements.summary: Finish the Prologue.

steps.text: Complete the main story in the @mechanic{Prologue}.

achievements.description: You completed Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 1.

steps.text: Complete the main story in the @mechanic{Chapter 1}.

achievements.description: You completed Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 2.

steps.text: Complete the main story in the @mechanic{Chapter 2}.

achievements.description: You completed Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 3.

steps.text: Complete the main story in the @mechanic{Chapter 3}.

achievements.description: You completed Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 4.

steps.text: Complete the main story in the @mechanic{Chapter 4}.

achievements.description: You finished the game.
achievements.summary: Finish final chapter.

steps.text: Complete the main story in the @mechanic{final chapter}.

achievements.description: You became a Votary (Dogmatic) and completed the game on Daring difficulty or above.
achievements.summary: Finish the game at Votary rank or higher in the Dogmatic conviction on Daring difficulty or higher.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Dogmatic} conviction options until that conviction reaches @mechanic{Votary} (rank III).
Keep the difficulty at @mechanic{Daring} or higher through the playthrough and finish the story.

achievements.description: You became a Votary (Iconoclast) and completed the game on Daring difficulty or above.
achievements.summary: Finish the game at Votary rank or higher in the Iconoclast conviction on Daring difficulty or higher.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Iconoclast} conviction options until that conviction reaches @mechanic{Votary} (rank III).
Keep the difficulty at @mechanic{Daring} or higher through the playthrough and finish the story.

achievements.description: You became a Votary (Heretical) and completed the game on Daring difficulty or above.
achievements.summary: Finish the game at Votary rank or higher in the Heretical conviction on Daring difficulty or higher.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Heretical} conviction options until that conviction reaches @mechanic{Votary} (rank III).
Keep the difficulty at @mechanic{Daring} or higher through the playthrough and finish the story.

achievements.description: You completed the game on Daring difficulty or above.
achievements.summary: Complete a playthrough at Daring difficulty or above.

steps.text: Start on @mechanic{Daring} or above, keep that difficulty throughout the run, and complete the final chapter.

achievements.description: You dodged 500 enemy attacks with your party members.
achievements.summary: Have party members dodge a total of 500 enemy attacks.

steps.text: Build @mechanic{Agility} and dodge on active party members, then accumulate 500 successful dodges in combat.

achievements.description: You performed 500 critical hits with your party members.
achievements.summary: Land 500 critical hits across your party.

steps.text: Use party members with critical-hit bonuses until the party has scored 500 critical hits.

achievements.description: You killed an enemy with 100 damage dealt by one attack.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a single attack that deals at least 100 damage.

steps.text: Use a high-damage attack to deal at least 100 damage and kill its target with that attack.

achievements.description: You killed 5 enemies with one attack.
achievements.summary: Kill at least 5 enemies in a single attack.

steps.text: Weaken a group of five enemies, then finish the group with one area attack, such as Cassia’s @mechanic{Lidless Stare}.

achievements.description: You gained a second-tier archetype.
achievements.summary: Choose a second-tier archetype for your character.

steps.text: At level @mechanic{16}, select a second-tier archetype during level-up.

achievements.description: You gained a third-tier archetype.
achievements.summary: Choose the Exemplar archetype for your character.

steps.text: At level @mechanic{36}, select @mechanic{Exemplar} during level-up.

achievements.description: You won your first void combat.
achievements.summary: Win one void battle.

steps.text: Defeat the enemy fleet in the first void battle at the start of Chapter 2.

achievements.description: You won 10 void combats.
achievements.summary: Win a total of 10 void battles.

steps.text: Engage enemy fleets on the star map and win ten void battles.

achievements.description: You destroyed at least one ship of every enemy fleet (pirates, Chaos, Asuryani, Drukhari, Necrons).
achievements.summary: Destroy at least one vessel from each of the five enemy fleet types.

steps.text: Defeat ships from the @enemy{pirates}, @enemy{Chaos}, @enemy{Asuryani}, and @enemy{Drukhari} fleets while exploring the Koronus Expanse.
In Chapter 5, destroy a @enemy{Necron} ship in the Debris of Battiada system.

achievements.description: You destroyed 30 torpedoes.
achievements.summary: Destroy 30 torpedoes with the flagship’s own weapons.

steps.text: Keep a torpedo-armed enemy ship alive long enough to launch torpedoes. The @loc{Hundred Dreams Crossroads} battle with two Infidel-Class Raiders is suitable.
Destroy 30 launched torpedoes with your flagship’s weapons. Later, the side macro-cannons’ @mechanic{Flak} mode makes interception easier.

achievements.description: You restarted the shields on your flagship and received no damage to the hull while doing so.
achievements.summary: Finish restarting your flagship’s shields without taking hull damage during the restart.

steps.text: Move beyond enemy firing range before restarting the flagship’s shields, then keep the hull undamaged until the shields finish restarting.

achievements.description: You reclaimed 5 colonies of the von Valancius dynasty.
achievements.summary: Reclaim all 5 original von Valancius colonies.

steps.text: Reclaim @loc{Foulstone}, @loc{Janus}, @loc{Kiava Gamma}, and @loc{Dargonus}. Preserve Foulstone as a colony.
After reaching Dargonus, visit @loc{Vheabos VI} in @loc{Mortus Acies} to reclaim the fifth colony.

achievements.description: You completed a colony project of the highest tier.
achievements.summary: Complete a tier V project in one colony.

steps.text: From Chapter 4, develop a colony through its project tiers and finish a @mechanic{tier V} project.

achievements.description: You completed the highest-tier colony project on 5 of your colonies.
achievements.summary: Complete a tier V project in each of the 5 original colonies.

steps.text: Finish a @mechanic{tier V} project in each original colony: @loc{Janus}, @loc{Dargonus}, @loc{Foulstone}, @loc{Vheabos VI}, and @loc{Kiava Gamma}.

achievements.description: You completed 20 contracts.
achievements.summary: Fulfil 20 contracts.

steps.text: Check the journal’s @mechanic{Contracts} section as exploration and colony projects add contracts, and supply the resources for twenty contracts.

achievements.description: You melted the ice planet.
achievements.summary: Melt the frozen world in the Hundred Dreams Crossroads system.

steps.text: Install an improved ship augur, such as the @item{X-470 Ultimo Array}. Scan the @loc{Ice World} in @loc{Hundred Dreams Crossroads} after obtaining the @mechanic{In the Footsteps of History} rumour.
After the enhanced scan, select the planet’s climate-modification option.
Request Mechanicus assistance to unlock @mechanic{Melting the Ice}. Complete that contract by supplying @item{3 Chemicals}, @item{1 Flogiston}, and @item{5 Promethium}.

achievements.description: You charted a new path through the warp from one system to another.
achievements.summary: Chart a new warp route between two star systems.

steps.text: On the Chapter 2 star map, spend @mechanic{Navigator’s Insight} to create a route connecting two systems.

achievements.description: You visited all the systems in the Koronus Expanse.
achievements.summary: Visit every star system in the Koronus Expanse.

steps.text: Visit each newly available star system in Chapters 2 and 4 before leaving the Expanse. Recheck the map after story and companion quests open systems.
Visit the Chapter 5 systems as they become accessible.

achievements.description: You scanned all available worlds.
achievements.summary: Scan every available world.

steps.text: Scan every planet in each star system before moving on, including newly opened systems in later chapters.
Return to the @npc{Explorators} on @loc{Footfall} regularly and report your planetary discoveries.

achievements.description: Playing on Daring difficulty or above, you did not let the Chaos Spawn consume any cultists at the end of the Prologue.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Prologue Chaos Spawn on Daring or higher without letting it consume any cultists.

steps.text: On @mechanic{Daring} or above, kill the accompanying cultists before focusing attacks on the @enemy{Chaos Spawn}. Do not allow the boss to use a cultist to heal.

achievements.description: Playing on Daring difficulty or above, you did not let any shuttles be destroyed at the end of Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Defeat Aurora on Daring or higher while keeping every evacuation shuttle intact.

steps.text: In Chapter 1’s final fight on @mechanic{Daring} or above, kill @enemy{Aurora} quickly or disable him before he can destroy an evacuation shuttle.

achievements.description: You killed the Daemon of Tzeentch in the sewers under the Upperway.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Daemon of Tzeentch beneath the Upperway.

steps.text: On @loc{Rykad Minoris}, enter the warehouse from the @loc{Upperway} and reach the sewers.
Examine the cultist’s body at the far end of the sewers to summon the @enemy{Daemon of Tzeentch}, then defeat the daemon.

achievements.description: You visited half of the optional locations.
achievements.summary: Visit half of the optional locations.

steps.text: Scan planets, wrecks, and stations, then land at newly revealed sites marked with a shuttle icon until you have visited half of the optional locations.

achievements.description: You visited all optional locations.
achievements.summary: Visit every optional location.

steps.text: Before ending Chapters 2 and 4, scan the map’s worlds and enter every optional landing site. Save before scans and Awareness checks that can reveal a hidden site.
Buy the @item{X-470 Ultimo Array} from the @npc{Imperial Navy} trader after reaching @mechanic{Profit Factor 70} and @mechanic{reputation level 7}.

In Chapter 4, install the @item{X-470 Ultimo Array} and rescan @loc{Omicron}’s Savannah World for the @loc{Magnetic Storm} site. Also revisit the newly available @loc{Abandoned Palace} in @loc{Mundus Nullius} and the @loc{Ice World} in @loc{Frozen Prince}.

achievements.description: You solved all the puzzles at the unidentified ruins.
achievements.summary: Solve every puzzle in the Unidentified Ruins.

steps.text: Land at the @loc{Unidentified Ruins} on the Dead World in @loc{Latotian’s Passage}. Take the @item{Cracked Xenochest} and uncover the floor symbol beyond the rock obstruction.
Pass the central pillar’s Lore (Warp) check. Rotate the centre twice, then follow the light around the outside and turn each of the four outer pillars twice. Take the @item{Ancient Force Sword}.

Place the Cracked Xenochest in the empty statue mouth. Rotate the central pillar three times. Turn the upper-right pillar once, the lower-right twice, the lower-left once, and the upper-left three times.
Open the revealed chest and defeat the enemies that appear.

achievements.description: You prevented 7 combats through dialogue.
achievements.summary: Avoid 7 fights through dialogue.

steps.text: Choose peaceful dialogue outcomes whenever a conversation can prevent a fight; resolve seven encounters this way.

achievements.displayName: Those Who Are About to Die Salute You
achievements.description: You let the Khymerae tear apart all the gladiators in the first battle in the Commorragh arena.
achievements.summary: Let the Khymerae kill every allied gladiator in the first Commorragh arena fight.

steps.text: During the first @loc{Commorragh} arena battle, hold your party back and let the @enemy{Khymerae} kill all the allied gladiators before you kill the beasts.

achievements.description: You used stimms to remove all debuffs from the Rogue Trader before meeting Malice.
achievements.summary: Use stimms to clear the Rogue Trader’s removable injuries before meeting Malice.

steps.text: After waking in @loc{Commorragh}, pass Awareness checks to find @item{Stimm} doses in rubble. For more doses, defeat the nearby beggars and loot their bodies.
Use the stimms before meeting @npc{Malice} until @mechanic{Hamstrung}, @mechanic{Darkened Eye}, and @mechanic{Deformed Bones} are gone. @mechanic{A Hundred Wounds} can remain.

achievements.description: You killed a defiler without destroying any of the 4 plasma batteries strengthening it.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Incongruous Defiler while leaving its 4 plasma batteries intact.

steps.text: On @loc{Eufrates II}, focus your attacks on the @enemy{Incongruous Defiler} and leave all four @mechanic{plasma batteries} standing. Armour-reducing abilities help overcome their protection.

achievements.description: You resolved the crisis on Janus.
achievements.summary: Resolve the main crisis on Janus.

steps.text: Complete the main-story objectives on @loc{Janus}.

achievements.description: You decided the fate of Kiava Gamma.
achievements.summary: Resolve the main crisis on Kiava Gamma.

steps.text: Complete the main-story objectives on @loc{Kiava Gamma}.

achievements.description: You secured Dargonus.
achievements.summary: Secure Dargonus against the Drukhari attack.

steps.text: Complete the main-story defence of @loc{Dargonus}.

achievements.description: You handed over Idira, Yrliet, and Marazhai to the Inquisition.
achievements.summary: Surrender the companions Idira, Marazhai, and Yrliet to the Inquisition.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Idira} in the Prologue, @npc{Yrliet} on Janus, and @npc{Marazhai} in Commorragh. Keep all three until Chapter 4.
Make a separate save, then speak with @npc{Heinrix} and surrender each of those three companions to the Inquisition.

achievements.description: You learned the Necron language.
achievements.summary: Learn to understand the Necron language.

steps.text: In Chapter 5’s @loc{Debris of Battiada} system, land at the Ice World’s signal site. Before using the central cogitator, pass the two Lore (Xenos) checks and the Tech-Use check around the complex.
Use the cogitator and pass its Tech-Use check. Activate the information panels, begin final cataloguing, and transfer the data to your Elucidator.
Choose to extract data about the machine’s masters and continue the attempt.

achievements.description: You started a romance.
achievements.summary: Begin a romance with a companion.

steps.text: Choose romantic dialogue with a compatible companion: @npc{Cassia} for a male Rogue Trader, @npc{Heinrix} for a female Rogue Trader, or @npc{Jae} for either.

achievements.description: You found your true love.
achievements.summary: Reach a companion’s true-love romance ending.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Yrliet} on Janus. Show interest in her culture, accept her teachings, and avoid overt flirting.
Keep the relationship through her companion events. If asked to choose between partners in Chapter 4, commit to Yrliet and finish her romance storyline.

achievements.description: You recruited a secret companion.
achievements.summary: Recruit a secret companion.

steps.text: Follow the @mechanic{Heretical} route on @loc{Eufrates II} and pledge yourself to the @enemy{Edge of Daybreak}.
After the subsequent Space Wolves battle, accept @npc{Uralon the Cruel} when he offers to join before Chapter 5.

achievements.description: You raised your own abomination.
achievements.summary: Let Nomos absorb the C’tan Shard.

steps.text: Develop @npc{Nomos} through @mechanic{The Possessed Ship}. Before landing on @loc{Epitaph}, agree to let Nomos use Asclepios’s body and accompany you.
Keep Nomos alive in the final battle, then give Nomos the @enemy{C’tan Shard}.

achievements.description: You discovered the truth about Theodora's death.
achievements.summary: Hear Argenta’s confession about Theodora’s death.

steps.text: Bring @npc{Argenta} into Chapter 3 and recover her in @loc{Commorragh}. When she asks for your trust before the arena, agree to hear her confession.

achievements.description: You wore the Halo Device.
achievements.summary: Equip the Halo Device.

steps.text: Visit the @loc{Abandoned Palace} on @loc{Mundus Nullius}’s Ice World. Examine the corpse, defeat the boss, and take the @item{Halo Device}.
Save, return to your private chambers, and equip the device where @npc{Heinrix}, @npc{Yrliet}, and @npc{Marazhai} cannot stop you.

achievements.description: Acquire the golden xeno-idol.
achievements.summary: Acquire the golden xeno-idol.

steps.text: In Chapter 4, follow the @mechanic{Rare Find} rumour to the Rocky World in @loc{Cradle of Khepri}. Loot the @item{golden xeno-idol} from the site’s chest, then approach the area with three servitors.

achievements.description: Enrage Marazhai during the governor’s camp confrontation.
achievements.summary: Enrage Marazhai during the governor’s camp confrontation.

steps.text: At the governor’s camp on @loc{Grantis} in @loc{Palatium Stellos}, mock @npc{Marazhai} with the taunt about the beast speaking your language. Pass the hidden Coercion check.
Next, taunt him about someone beating him at his own game and pass the second Coercion check. Continue with the reply about being smarter than you look.
Finally, say you dozed off during his speech and ask him to start again. Pass the third Coercion check to provoke his outburst.

achievements.displayName: This Is a Job for the Lord Captain!
achievements.description: Have the Rogue Trader personally enter the sewage on Footfall.
achievements.summary: Have the Rogue Trader personally enter the sewage on Footfall.

steps.text: Arrive on @loc{Footfall} incognito. At the pirate funeral, let @npc{Daggen} believe you are Fidelio and accept the clerk’s request to enter the crematorium.
Save before entering the furnace. When the door closes, pause and break the floor plate to escape into the tunnels.
At the sewage crossing, volunteer the @mechanic{Rogue Trader} to go through.

achievements.description: Recover the boots stolen from the Rogue Trader in Commorragh.
achievements.summary: Recover the boots stolen from the Rogue Trader in Commorragh.

steps.text: Have boots equipped before entering Chapter 3. After waking in @loc{Commorragh}, confront the nearby @npc{Ugly Beggar}, kill him, and recover the stolen boots.

achievements.description: Enter the hidden bunker at the distress-signal site.
achievements.summary: Enter the hidden bunker at the distress-signal site.

steps.text: Investigate the distress signal on @loc{Cradle of Khepri}’s Ice World. Destroy the transmitter and defeat the turrets.
Pass the @mechanic{Awareness} checks at the ice wall beyond the final turrets, break through the revealed wall, and enter the bunker. Save before the checks.

achievements.description: Award the pirate funeral inheritance to Adelia.
achievements.summary: Award the pirate funeral inheritance to Adelia.

steps.text: At @loc{Footfall}’s pirate funeral, speak with @npc{Adelia} behind the crates near the chaplain. Bring @npc{Abelard}, inspect the corpse, remembrance book, and amasec, and question the guests.
Explain to the chaplain that @mechanic{Repentance} is a ship. Speak that name to the servitor beside @npc{Daggen} to identify Fidelio.
When deciding the inheritance, use the @mechanic{Iconoclast: Follower} option to give it to Adelia.

achievements.description: Surrender Eufrates II to Chaos.
achievements.summary: Surrender Eufrates II to Chaos.

steps.text: Follow the @mechanic{Heretical} choices in the Eufrates II war council and assault.
When confronting @npc{Uralon}, say @mechanic{Sameth}. Complete the ritual and pledge yourself to the @enemy{Edge of Daybreak}.

achievements.description: Discover Nomos’s origins.
achievements.summary: Discover Nomos’s origins.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, retrieve Theodora’s data cache from @loc{Kiava Gamma}. Take the valve from the eastern cart, use it beside the stuck panel beyond the Chaos Marines, then use the hidden cogitator to disable gas and traps and take the data.

On @loc{Dargonus}, press the hidden button by the chair in your palace room. In the secret room, choose @item{Litany of the Motive Force}, @item{Flame of Purity} wine, and @mechanic{Symphony of Honor and Duty, 2nd Movement} to obtain the second cache.
Give both caches to @npc{IH-630}. Join @npc{Pasqal}’s machine-spirit ritual before the coronation. Preserve Nomos, speak to the bridge officers about the incident, and report their answers to Nomos.
Speak with Nomos at the Dargonus ceremony and again in Chapter 4. When @npc{Asclepios} boards during a warp journey, hear him out and spare him.
After that meeting, exhaust Nomos’s dialogue about the data caches and his origins.

achievements.description: Subdue the entity in the Bottomless Pit.
achievements.summary: Subdue the entity in the Bottomless Pit.

steps.text: As a @mechanic{Psyker} Rogue Trader, visit the Jungle World’s anomaly in @loc{System Speculo}. Examine the wall engravings, then choose to dominate the pit’s entity and pass the @mechanic{Willpower} check.

achievements.description: Obtain the weapon Sweet Perdition.
achievements.summary: Obtain the weapon Sweet Perdition.

steps.text: After the second @loc{Commorragh} arena battle, return toward @npc{Tervantias} to trigger the Drukhari hunt. Wait to study the prey, then choose @mechanic{I act!}.
Take the @mechanic{Awareness} option about the prey searching the minarets. Make the prey run, then pass the @mechanic{Agility} option to escape through passing crowds.
Continue the hunt and pass @mechanic{Willpower}. Take the @mechanic{Lore (Xenos)} option to slip away as if you know the city intimately.
Advance toward the conclusion and pass @mechanic{Carouse}. Attack when the prey appears defenceless, then pass @mechanic{Demolition} to survive the trap.
Advance to the final moments and pass the @mechanic{Strength} option about the prey using brute force. Receive @item{Sweet Perdition}, then finish the story event.

achievements.description: Finish Jae’s sewer rescue without alerting the guards.
achievements.summary: Finish Jae’s sewer rescue without alerting the guards.

steps.text: In Chapter 4, speak with @npc{Jae} and follow her Footfall rescue quest to @loc{Amasecus}. Speak to the bartender and enter the nearby sewer before resolving the Chorda–Vladaym conflict.
Set up the gas canister and activate the sewer valves while avoiding patrols. Pass the Demolition checks; reload if combat begins.
Use the northwest cogitator to release the gas, then reach Jae’s companions in the northwest room.

achievements.description: Wait through the Administratum queue during Jae’s certificate quest.
achievements.summary: Wait through the Administratum queue during Jae’s certificate quest.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Jae} on Footfall and accept her request for a @item{Mercatum Tabula Officiale}. Follow the servo-skull in Dargonus’s Administratum to the @npc{Mistress of Seals}.
Have the documents signed by @npc{Atilius Quint} on Janus and @npc{Clementia Werserian} in Dargonus’s palace. Obtain the seals from Janus’s rebel base and the old bunker in @loc{Nameless Star}.
Return the sealed paperwork. Agree to wait, then select @mechanic{Take a seat in the line}. Keep choosing to continue and wait patiently until the clerk sees you.

achievements.description: Swear allegiance to the C’tan at the ending.
achievements.summary: Swear allegiance to the C’tan at the ending.

steps.text: Save before the final ending choices. After the last battle, choose the outcome in which the Rogue Trader kneels and serves the @enemy{C’tan}.

achievements.description: Die while attempting the warp route to the Imperium.
achievements.summary: Die while attempting the warp route to the Imperium.

steps.text: Make a separate save early in Chapter 2. Select the @loc{Imperium} destination below @loc{Furibundus} on the star map.
Keep taking the onward warp choices through @loc{Ermitage}, @loc{Witch-Cursed World}, and @loc{Wandering Port} until the expedition ends in death.

achievements.description: You completed the game with any Conviction: Zealot on Daring difficulty or above.
achievements.summary: Finish the game at Zealot rank in any conviction on Daring or higher.

steps.text: Stay at @mechanic{Daring} difficulty or above. Consistently take one conviction’s choices until it reaches @mechanic{Zealot} (rank V), then complete the story.

achievements.description: Defeat the Genestealer Cult aboard your flagship.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Genestealer Cult aboard your flagship.

steps.text: During Chapter 4’s ship uprising, survive the freight-line battles and return to the bridge. Reject @npc{Sire}’s offer, then defeat Sire and the cult reinforcements.

achievements.description: Defeat the vision of the Undying One.
achievements.summary: Defeat the vision of the Undying One.

steps.text: After defeating the ship’s cult, follow @npc{Jocasta}’s report to the Astropathic Heart. Complete the ritual and learn the name @npc{Naaki Erebis}.
Ask @npc{Janris Danrok} about the name, then have @npc{Clementia} arrange the Erebis reception on Dargonus. Question the family and speak with Kibellah afterward.
Follow Kibellah to the Vizier and defeat the ensuing enemies and the @enemy{Undying One} vision. Complete the conversation afterward.

achievements.description: You dispelled the shadows in the void.
achievements.summary: Complete Kibellah’s romance storyline.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, discuss Kibellah’s rituals and offer to show her yours. Ask @npc{Janris Danrok} to arrange a ceremony, attend it on the officers’ deck after several warp jumps, and begin the romance.
Support Kibellah through her companion story and keep the romance active through its final scene.

achievements.description: You defeated the ship's confessor without letting the Rogue Trader suffer any damage.
achievements.summary: Defeat Confessor Adalbert without the Rogue Trader taking damage.

steps.text: During @mechanic{A Card Inverted}, keep the Rogue Trader away from @enemy{Adalbert} and enemy attacks. Let the other companions defeat the confessor, keeping the Rogue Trader clear of his death explosion.

achievements.description: You killed 3 enemies in one turn using the Death Waltz ability.
achievements.summary: Kill at least 3 enemies with Death Waltz in one turn.

steps.text: Use @npc{Kibellah}’s @mechanic{Death Waltz} heroic or desperate action near at least three weakened enemies and kill them during that turn.

achievements.description: You saved all Astropaths during the telepathic ritual.
achievements.summary: Keep every Astropath alive through the telepathic ritual.

steps.text: When @npc{Weisz} objects to the ritual, discuss outside help and hire a supporting psyker for @mechanic{3 Profit Factor}. Wait for @npc{Herimon}’s arrival and return to the Astropathic Chapel.
Complete the ritual’s two Willpower checks. Protect every Astropath during the apparition and daemon battles, including Weisz.

achievements.description: You forced the Magus to kill himself with his own attack.
achievements.summary: Have the Magus deliver the fatal blow to himself.

steps.text: During Chapter 2’s crypt battle, lure the Magus’s delayed red-circle attacks onto the stone bastions to break his protection. Move away before each strike.
Weaken the @enemy{Magus}, then position a marked party member beside him. Move the party clear after the attack is committed so the blast kills the Magus.

achievements.description: You saved Captain Klein on the freight line.
achievements.summary: Save Captain Klein during the freight-line uprising.

steps.text: Spare @npc{Jinevra} during the Chapter 2 investigation.
During Chapter 4’s freight-line attack, leave the train controls instead of sending the train into the fighting. Defeat the mutants and speak with @npc{Captain Klein}.

achievements.description: You caught a suspicious rash on the freight line and did not cure it by the end of the game.
achievements.summary: Finish the game with the Suspicious Rash caught on the freight line still untreated.

steps.text: On the first freight-line visit, search the outcasts’ belongings near the large fan until you acquire @mechanic{Suspicious Rash} and the @mechanic{Dermatological Treatment} quest.
Leave the rash untreated through the ending. During the Bloodspun Web’s blood bath, avoid the statue prayer or upward gaze that cures it.

achievements.description: You successfully mingled with people of much lower rank.
achievements.summary: Mingle successfully with the freight-line workers.

steps.text: On the @loc{Freight Line}, play the flutist’s game fairly, play again with cheating, and offer a button before leaving.
Talk with the foreman at the green vat, eat the slop, and pass the offered skill check.

achievements.description: You destroyed 4 ships using attack crafts.
achievements.summary: Destroy 4 enemy ships with attack craft.

steps.text: Defeat the two fleets encountered at @loc{Mu-Rho 79}, then equip the unlocked attack craft in your ship’s arsenal.
Use the attack craft to deliver the final damage to four enemy ships.

achievements.description: You made effective use of every special zone in void battles at least once.
achievements.summary: Use every type of special void-combat zone at least once.

steps.text: Use a @mechanic{Gas and Dust Cloud} and a @mechanic{Charged Particle Accumulation} during void combat, such as the battles in @loc{Hundred Dreams Crossroads}.
Use @mechanic{Explosive Void Nebula} in @loc{System Speculo} and an @mechanic{Asteroid Field} in @loc{Latotian’s Passage}. Follow each zone’s tooltip; fire macro-cannons in the explosive nebula.

achievements.description: Uncover every secret in the voidship shrine.
achievements.summary: Uncover every secret in the voidship shrine.

steps.text: Early in Chapter 2, visit the @loc{Voidship Shrine}. Open @npc{Initiate Ziek}’s orb with the answers @mechanic{Throne}, @mechanic{Blood}, @mechanic{Weakness}, @mechanic{Purity}.

For @npc{Initiate Klotus}, identify the confessions by speaking to @npc{Janris Danrok} about the orphans, @npc{Vigdis} about the Kleppas, and @npc{Zacchary Weisz} about the remaining confession. Return to Klotus.
Detect and press the button near the relic between the doors. Place five different party members on the pressure plates spelling @mechanic{FURIA} and collect the revealed hammer.

achievements.description: You performed the telepathic ritual with Idira as your assistant.
achievements.summary: Complete the telepathic ritual with Idira assisting.

steps.text: Tell @npc{Weisz} to use @npc{Idira} as the ritual’s assistant. Pass the ritual’s two Willpower checks and win the resulting fight.

achievements.displayName: This Task Is for the Lord Captain Only
achievements.description: You were self-sufficient when dealing with the blood bath mystery.
achievements.summary: Personally lead the investigation of the blood-bath mystery.

steps.text: When the blood bath occurs, insist on investigating personally. Question the officers, then take the scalpel and conduct the autopsy. Examine the organs, wounds, identifying marks, and blood trail.
Follow the trail to the ventilation shaft and inspect the caught provost’s coat. Use the master cogitator yourself, pass Tech-Use and Logic, and ask about @mechanic{ES-246-01}.

Question Hrotko’s suspect, expose the false confession with the available checks, and compare your findings with Sauerback. Accuse Hrotko of changing the evidence, then question Gwedon and summon the Vizier.
After the telepathic ritual, insist on visiting the reactors yourself. Question the Inferni Master and Nije, inspect the cult symbol and hidden caches, and propose an ambush.

Personally supervise the captured cultist’s interrogation and extract the hideout location. Finish the crypt confrontation and the later @mechanic{A Card Inverted} investigation, then speak with Kibellah.

achievements.description: You became a spinner of the Bloodspun Web.
achievements.summary: Become an initiated member of the Bloodspun Web.

steps.text: On the @loc{Freight Line}, follow the blood symbols. End the burned man’s suffering, then tell the suicidal man you did not come to kill him and walk away.
Pass the Athletics check to jump into the fan. When the @npc{Vizier} recognises your trials, accept initiation into the @mechanic{Bloodspun Web}.

achievements.description: You were less than precise with heavy machinery.
achievements.summary: Kill a freight-line worker by dropping a crane’s container.

steps.text: At the @loc{Freight Line} crane controls, use the left and middle levers to move the crane toward the upper-left, then use the right lever to lower it. Secure the container on the floor.
Return to the controls. Use the right lever to raise the load, the middle lever to move it, then the right lever to drop it on the worker in the striped zone.

achievements.description: You decided the fate of the freight line of your voidship.
achievements.summary: Decide how the flagship’s freight line will be governed.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{The Lowest Walk of Life} by investigating the freight line and following its blood symbols. Report back to @npc{Eddock Frensoe} and choose the freight line’s future.

achievements.description: You took a bath with every available companion.
achievements.summary: Bathe with Kibellah and every non-secret base-game companion.

guide.context: Recruit Ulfar and Marazhai before leaving Commorragh. Keep the required companions available until you have bathed with each one.

achievements.description: Accept Sire’s offer to join the Genestealer Cult.
achievements.summary: Accept Sire’s offer to join the Genestealer Cult.

guide.context: Accepting this offer ends the run. Make a separate save first.

steps.text: Save before the Chapter 4 confrontation with @npc{Sire}. Ask what Sire is, suggest negotiation, and choose @mechanic{Give up the futile struggle} to accept the cult’s unity.

achievements.description: You completed the game in Grim Darkness mode.
achievements.summary: Complete a playthrough in Grim Darkness mode.

steps.text: Enable @mechanic{Grim Darkness} when beginning a new game and finish that run without the Rogue Trader’s party being wiped out.

achievements.description: You experienced the full force of the Lex Imperialis and survived.
achievements.summary: Survive the final Lex Imperialis confrontation.

steps.text: Complete the @mechanic{Lex Imperialis} story, defend yourself at the Palace of Justice, and survive the final confrontation after deciding the Marshal’s fate.

achievements.description: You found all the impostors.
achievements.summary: Identify every impostor in Thassera’s hunt.

steps.text: On @loc{Thassera}, accept the governor’s impostor hunt after the banquet.
Question @npc{Edytka} and let her go. Find the man with scissors, the old and young priests, and the young woman wearing a fine dress.
Brand these three impostors: the young woman wearing a fine dress, the man carrying scissors, and the old priest.

achievements.displayName: Of Course I Know What I'm Doing!
achievements.description: Have the Rogue Trader personally enter the tank on Leethus.
achievements.summary: Have the Rogue Trader personally enter the tank on Leethus.

steps.text: During the @loc{Leethus} fighting, when @npc{Solomorne} asks who will enter the tank, volunteer the @mechanic{Rogue Trader}.

achievements.description: Have 4 different types of familiar in the party at the same time.
achievements.summary: Have 4 different types of familiar in the party at the same time.

steps.text: Field @npc{Solomorne} with his @mechanic{Cyber-Mastiff} alongside three @mechanic{Overseers} using a @mechanic{Psyber-Raven}, @mechanic{Cyber-Eagle}, and @mechanic{Servo-Skull Swarm}. The raven’s handler must be a psyker.

achievements.description: You received a complete inventory of the Rogue Trader.
achievements.summary: Receive the scribe’s complete inventory of the Rogue Trader.

steps.text: On @loc{Leethus}, let @npc{Clerk Tertius Quart} catalogue the retinue and the Rogue Trader. Answer every question and comply with his requests to turn around and undress until he gives you the inventory.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, the Cyber-Mastiff bit at least 7 different enemies in one turn.
achievements.summary: Make the Cyber-Mastiff bite at least 7 different enemies within one turn on Daring or higher.

steps.text: On @mechanic{Daring} or above, use the @loc{Leethus} fight with Captain Walz’s crowded troops. Position an ally where at least seven enemies gather.
Use Solomorne’s @mechanic{Protect!} so Glaito bites the surrounding enemies. Follow with @mechanic{Apprehend!} and @mechanic{Bite!} as needed, reaching seven distinct targets in that same turn.

achievements.description: You successfully petted Glaito.
achievements.summary: Successfully pet Glaito.

steps.text: After boarding the Heartless, speak to @npc{Solomorne} aboard your ship. Choose @mechanic{Hello Glaito}, offer to pet Glaito, and pass @mechanic{Lore (Imperium)}. Save before trying; two failures make Glaito refuse.

achievements.description: Learn the true identity of Leethus’s watcher.
achievements.summary: Learn the true identity of Leethus’s watcher.

steps.text: At the watcher’s station after Leethus, keep questioning the @npc{Watcher} after Solomorne intervenes. Do not settle the tithe immediately.
When the name option appears, pass the @mechanic{Commerce} check. Claim the tithe, choose the @mechanic{Dogmatic} response, and pass the Persuasion check to persuade Solomorne.

achievements.description: You hit at least 7 enemies with a single shot from a tank.
achievements.summary: Strike at least 7 enemies in one tank-cannon blast.

steps.text: At @loc{Leethus}, gather at least seven enemies in the tank’s firing area, using @mechanic{Point of Curiosity} if needed. Fire one tank shell through the group.

achievements.description: You successfully ate all three dishes on Thassera.
achievements.summary: Successfully eat each of the 3 banquet dishes on Thassera.

steps.text: At @loc{Thassera}’s banquet, pass the checks for the giant alcedonte ham, five-tailed crevimperius, and clams. Start with your weakest check because each eaten dish adds penalties, then finish the conversation.

achievements.description: You poked your nose into all the available containers on Leethus.
achievements.summary: Search every available container on Leethus.

steps.text: Explore every section of @loc{Leethus} and open all containers, including those on elevated platforms and in the Sand Boss area.
Activate machinery that exposes loot and send @npc{Glaito} through the sand tube to retrieve its hidden chest before leaving.

achievements.description: You boarded the Heartless without destroying any of its compartments.
achievements.summary: Board the Heartless without destroying any compartments.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Heartless} in @loc{Mundus Nullius}. Decline Ravor’s proposal for further attacks or sabotage, board immediately with Solomorne, and defeat the captain.

achievements.description: Gather all evidence needed to expose Thassera’s conspiracy.
achievements.summary: Gather all evidence needed to expose Thassera’s conspiracy.

steps.text: On @loc{Thassera}, pass the arrival Awareness check on Ruoldo’s riding. Examine the lacerax, question @npc{Tavrisk} with Lore (Warp), read the street flyers, and attend the execution.

Question the governor about the lacerax and pass Commerce and Persuasion. During Solomorne’s private discussion, point out the strange circumstances, exhaust the deductions, and finish with the coded phrase.

achievements.description: You defeated the captain of the Heartless.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Heartless’s captain.

steps.text: Board the @enemy{Heartless} in @loc{Mundus Nullius} and defeat its captain on the bridge. Disable the secondary engines during the fight to stop the warp-jump countdown.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, you used Obstruct Vision to kill at least 3 enemies in one fight.
achievements.summary: Kill at least 3 enemies affected by Obstruct Vision in one fight on Daring or higher.

steps.text: On @mechanic{Daring} or above, use an Overseer with a @mechanic{Cyber-Eagle}. Weaken at least three enemies in the same battle.
Apply @mechanic{Obstruct Vision} with the eagle, then finish the affected enemies before the eagle leaves and the effect expires.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, you had at least 15 creatures at once in the Extrapolation area.
achievements.summary: Have at least 15 creatures simultaneously within Extrapolation on Daring or higher.

steps.text: On @mechanic{Daring} or above, gather fifteen creatures close together with @npc{Cassia}’s @mechanic{Point of Curiosity}. Give the Servo-Skull handler an extra turn with @mechanic{Bring It Down!}, then use @mechanic{Relocation} to move the swarm so @mechanic{Extrapolation} covers the entire group.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, you "accidentally" knocked out a companion in the Warp Relay area.
achievements.summary: Knock out a companion inside Warp Relay’s area on Daring or higher.

steps.text: On @mechanic{Daring} or above, place an Overseer’s @mechanic{Psyber-Raven} so its @mechanic{Warp Relay} area includes an ally.
Knock that ally unconscious inside the area. One route is to place the ally in the zone during Leethus’s tank battle and hit the ally with the tank.

achievements.description: Successfully answer every accusation at the Palace of Justice.
achievements.summary: Successfully answer every accusation at the Palace of Justice.

steps.text: Save before the trial. Interrupt @npc{Strachs}, then pass the Coercion check, the Lore (Warp) or second Coercion check, and the Lore (Imperium) check.
Answer the next accusation using the response supported by your earlier choices, then pass the final Coercion check. Reload if any accusation is left unanswered.

achievements.description: You knocked out your companion with a tank shot.
achievements.summary: Knock a companion unconscious with the tank’s cannon.

steps.text: Save during @loc{Leethus}’s tank fight. Aim the tank cannon at a companion and fire until the shot knocks that companion unconscious.

achievements.description: Activate the Heartless’s xeno-artefact after enduring its pain.
achievements.summary: Activate the Heartless’s xeno-artefact after enduring its pain.

steps.text: Aboard the @enemy{Heartless}, use the small urn on the floor to power the two xeno devices. Select the apparatus beside the door and pass @mechanic{Lore (Xenos)}.
Touch the control panel and pass the @mechanic{Toughness} check to read the logs. Read every log, then pass Lore (Xenos) to open the spherical prison.

achievements.description: You survived the machinations of Trazyn the Infinite.
achievements.summary: Escape Trazyn’s collection and return to the flagship.

steps.text: During the final confrontation with @npc{Trazyn}, refuse his bargain and defeat him.
When he opens an exit portal, refuse to enter it. Return safely to the flagship and finish the concluding conversation.

achievements.description: Hand Seberian over to the Inquisition during the time loop.
achievements.summary: Hand Seberian over to the Inquisition during the time loop.

steps.text: In the @loc{Dargonus} time loop, side with @npc{Juvenna} and follow @mechanic{Whispered Negotiations}. Call off the air strikes to keep Exalt-117 available.
Win @npc{Sergeant Zarkov}, @npc{Laria Voigtvir}, and @npc{Exalt-117} over to the betrayal. Steal the blade and obtain the door’s activation codes.
Finish Juvenna’s plan to deliver @npc{Seberian} to the Inquisition.

achievements.description: Help Seberian win the conflict in the time loop.
achievements.summary: Help Seberian win the conflict in the time loop.

steps.text: In the @loc{Dargonus} time loop, speak with @npc{Laria} first, expose @npc{Juvenna}’s betrayal, and follow @mechanic{Call to Allies}.
Steal the blade and recruit the support of @npc{Exalt-117}, @npc{Camilla Drivestem}, and @npc{Isimond Sauerback}.
Defeat the Inquisition forces to secure @npc{Seberian}’s victory.

achievements.description: Find Seberian von Valancius’s hidden study.
achievements.summary: Find Seberian von Valancius’s hidden study.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, wait for the crew’s report of a concealed room behind the augmentation chair. Visit the room and put your hand in the scanner to open @npc{Seberian von Valancius}’s study.

achievements.description: Trade both Seberian and Nomos to Trazyn.
achievements.summary: Trade both Seberian and Nomos to Trazyn.

steps.text: Keep @npc{Nomos} available through his storyline and retain @npc{Seberian} for the final Trazyn confrontation.
Accept Trazyn’s offer to exchange Seberian for the Warrant. Accept the next offer to exchange Nomos for help against Calcazar.

achievements.description: Become a permanent exhibit in Trazyn’s collection.
achievements.summary: Become a permanent exhibit in Trazyn’s collection.

guide.context: The offered portal ends the run. Make a separate save before this confrontation.

steps.text: Save before the final @npc{Trazyn} encounter. Refuse his bargain, defeat him, then enter the portal he offers as your exit.

achievements.description: You activated the xenodevice in the hardlight lab.
achievements.summary: Activate the xenodevice in the hardlight laboratory.

steps.text: In the @loc{Museion}, enter the laboratory after examining the dead tech-priest beyond the Chronomancer fight. Speak with the central Astartes, then choose @mechanic{Activate the rightmost chain} at the console.

achievements.description: You used galvanisation on augments in every slot.
achievements.summary: Use galvanisation on an augment in every augmentation slot.

steps.text: Install compatible augments and use their @mechanic{galvanisation} abilities during combat. Credit can be accumulated over several fights.
Activate @item{Cerebral Holo-Ocular (MK "Operative")} in the optical slot, @item{Extraction Node} in the cortical slot, and @item{Weapon Optimiser (MK-II)} in the somatic slot.
Activate @item{Hand of the Cursed} in the sinistral slot, @item{Chymist Combat Infuser} in the dextral slot, and @item{Grave-Core Circuit} in the musculoskeletal slot.

achievements.description: Decide Nuncius’s fate.
achievements.summary: Decide Nuncius’s fate.

steps.text: Follow @npc{Eogunn}’s companion story to @loc{Amsanct} and complete the final decision concerning @npc{Nuncius}.

achievements.description: You earned the respect of both Vedka and Izdrig at the same time.
achievements.summary: Earn simultaneous respect from Izdrig and Vedka.

steps.text: In @loc{Zarkov}’s camp, accept Batoshski’s anti-poison drink. Save the patient dying beside @npc{Chirurgeon Lukha}.
Succeed at the shooting range and settle the conflict in the cage without deaths.
Descend toward the Drover with @npc{Vedka} and @npc{Sergeant Janur} following you.

achievements.description: You completed Zarkov's colony chronicle.
achievements.summary: Finish Zarkov’s colony chronicle.

steps.text: Develop @loc{Zarkov} until you can complete a @mechanic{rank V} colony project, then finish that project.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, you killed the Drover without destroying its shoots.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Drover on Daring or higher while every shoot survives.

steps.text: On @mechanic{Daring} or above, focus all damage on the @enemy{Drover}. Kill the boss before the shoots reach three @mechanic{Maturation} stacks, and keep every shoot alive.

achievements.description: You tried to approach the Chronomancer 3 times in 1 round.
achievements.summary: Trigger the Chronomancer’s approach reset 3 times within one round.

steps.text: In @loc{Zarkov}’s tomb, walk three different party members close to the @enemy{Chronomancer} during the same round so @mechanic{Temporal Regression} sends each back. Walk normally rather than using Charge.

achievements.description: You upgraded the Implantation Throne in the Sector Bionica to the maximum level.
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade the Implantation Throne in Sector Bionica.

steps.text: Acquire a premium implant and try to use the @loc{Sector Bionica} augmentation throne to begin @mechanic{Premium Implants}.
Visit @loc{Altar-Templum-Calixis-Ext-17} and investigate its missing promethium shipments on @loc{Tirkuaz-4}. Complete @mechanic{Industrial Sabotage} to finish the throne upgrade.

achievements.description: Examine every exhibit in the Museion.
achievements.summary: Examine every exhibit in the Museion.

steps.text: Before leaving the @loc{Museion}, inspect every magnifying-glass point in each room. Speak with @npc{Trazyn} at each exhibit where he appears, and hear his explanations of displays you cannot inspect directly.

achievements.description: Save every settler during the Flayer assault on Daring or higher.
achievements.summary: Save every settler during the Flayer assault on Daring or higher.

steps.text: After the Aeldari void battle above @loc{Zarkov}, land at the attacked camp on @mechanic{Daring} or above. Defeat the @enemy{Flayers} while keeping every settlement NPC alive; heal their bleeding injuries as needed.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, you broke the Chronomancer's obelisk before its first activation.
achievements.summary: Break a Chronomancer obelisk before its first activation on Daring or higher.

steps.text: On @mechanic{Daring} or above, break an obelisk before the tomb’s @enemy{Chronomancer} takes his first turn. Use an @mechanic{Officer} who has chosen @mechanic{Grand Strategist}: act first, then use the Officer’s abilities to give a damage dealer an extra turn.
steps.note: Extra turns in this encounter have a 30-second limit, so choose your attacks quickly.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, you smashed the ice blocks on Amsanct using only generator overload.
achievements.summary: Destroy the large ice blocks on Amsanct solely with generator overload on Daring or higher.

steps.text: In @loc{Amsanct}’s Secret Facility, start the Necron encounter on @mechanic{Daring} or above. Leave the large ice blocks for the generator overload to destroy.
In round one, break the small ice obstruction at the bottom-right of the room, beside the entrance stairs, then activate the console.
In round two, clear the small obstruction beside the central console and the one at the lower-left walkway, then activate the console again.
In round three, clear the two small obstructions on the upper walkway, one near its left end and one beside the upper machinery. Activate the console to finish the overload chain.

achievements.description: You used every augmentation slot on your character.
achievements.summary: Fill every augmentation slot on the Rogue Trader.

steps.text: Use the @loc{Sector Bionica} throne to equip augments in the Rogue Trader’s optical, cortical, somatic, sinistral, dextral, and musculoskeletal slots, then close the augmentation menu.

achievements.description: You sent Batoshski or Dunawski on a doomed mission.
achievements.summary: Send Batoshski or Dunawski on the fatal diversion mission.

steps.text: Keep @npc{Batoshski} or @npc{Dunawski} as the ship’s @mechanic{Arch-Militant} after Zarkov.
During the storybook assault on Trazyn’s Museion, choose the option that sends the Arch-Militant and the loyal Zarkov fighter to sacrifice themselves and buy time.

achievements.description: You did not deviate in your management of the Sector Bionica.
achievements.summary: Keep the same augmentation policy throughout Sector Bionica’s decisions.

steps.text: For every @loc{Sector Bionica} policy decision, consistently support either the Vivisector’s access to implants for everyone or the Genetor’s restricted access. Keep the same policy until the post-attack procession reaches the bridge.

achievements.description: You solved the puzzle in the lost tomb on Zarkov.
achievements.summary: Solve the lost-tomb puzzle on Zarkov.

steps.text: After the @enemy{Chronomancer} fight, clear the obstruction to the @loc{Lost Tomb}’s puzzle chest. At its untouched console, operate the @mechanic{right lever}, then the @mechanic{middle console}, then the @mechanic{left lever twice}.

achievements.description: You solved the puzzle on Tirkuaz-4.
achievements.summary: Solve Tirkuaz-4’s valve puzzle.

steps.text: During @mechanic{Industrial Sabotage} on @loc{Tirkuaz-4}, find the valves at the map’s upper-left. From their initial positions, turn the @mechanic{right valve twice} until the indicator turns green.

achievements.description: You solved the puzzle in the Museion.
achievements.summary: Solve the Museion’s energy-tile puzzle.

steps.text: In the @loc{Museion}’s upper-right room, rotate the floor tiles so their glowing channels carry energy from the outer terminals into both central nodes.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, you took no damage from gas when fighting the soldiers of Krieg.
achievements.summary: Defeat the soldiers of Krieg without taking gas damage on Daring or higher.

steps.text: Equip the two protective masks on your damage dealers before speaking with the @loc{Museion}’s second @enemy{Chronomancer}, which starts the Krieg fight. On @mechanic{Daring} or above, use the masked characters to fight and keep the rest of the party clear of gas grenades and clouds.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, you destroyed the Aeldari ship in Zarkov's orbit.
achievements.summary: Destroy the Aeldari vessel above Zarkov on Daring or higher.

steps.text: When @loc{Zarkov} reports Aeldari ships in orbit, travel there on @mechanic{Daring} or above and destroy the @enemy{Wrath of Khaine}.

achievements.description: On Daring difficulty or above, you killed the Tech-Priests before they could reinforce the Defiler.
achievements.summary: Kill the Tech-Priests before they reinforce the Defiler on Daring or higher.

steps.text: On @mechanic{Daring} or above, prioritise the four @enemy{Demented Heretics} surrounding the @enemy{Defiler} in the Museion assault. Kill all four before they can reinforce the boss.
steps.note: If ToyBox is installed, disable it before attempting this fight.
